install: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund
build: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm cache clean --force && sleep 1 && find artifacts -type d -name .vite -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run predeploy --skip-env-check && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run build --workspace=artifacts/api-server
start: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run prepare:runtime-secrets && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production NODE_ENV=production node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
